<!-- Release: v0.9.1 -->

Development APK for Android 8 or newer. Signed with the project development key; updates the existing `.debug` app in place. Production distribution signing is not configured.

## Changes

- Fix album/search route rendering and focus, and prevent the scrollbar from blocking item menus
- Distinguish gallery sizes, give compact titles more space, and make the top dragged song follow the finger directly
- Remove the Library root search field; use the bottom Search button for global search

## Resolved issues

- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/31 - Gallery navigation, menu hitboxes, and drag responsiveness

## Install

1. Download `localica-v0.9.1-debug.apk` from **Assets** below.
2. Open it and allow installation from your browser or file manager if prompted.
3. Install over your existing development app to keep its data.
